description: Open the capture file /home/ga/Documents/captures/http.cap in Wireshark. Configure the Packet List to display ONLY the following 6 columns in this exact order: 'Time', 'Source', 'Destination', 'Host' (http.host), 'Method' (http.request.method), and 'URI' (http.request.uri). Change the 'Time' column format to 'UTC Date and Time of Day'. Remove all other columns (No., Protocol, Length, Info). Finally, export the packet list as a CSV file to /home/ga/Documents/captures/http_activity_log.csv.
